# Keep horizontal-scroll widget state and CSS preference state in agreement

The thread pane reads mail.threadpane.table.horizontal_scroll and assigns threadPane.treeTable.isHorizontalScroll. The table property changes column resizing rules, while CSS changes table layout under the same preference. The current source waits for an unresolved threadTree custom element before initial preference setup. Changing only CSS or only the JavaScript property misses part of the feature. Tests were read, not run.

Scope: mail/base/content.
